bio.text: John Kissel, a Republican, has represented District 7 in the Connecticut State Senate since 1993 and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.
He earned a B.S. from the University of Connecticut School of Education in 1981 and a J.D. from Western New England College School of Law in 1984.
His professional experience includes working as an attorney, as corporate attorney for Northeast Utilities, and as an adjunct professor at Bay Path College.
